Do yourself a favor and avoid this place. Within a month, the tint on my vehicle is bubbling, peeling, and poorly cut—it looks like it was done by an amateur. Every window has issues: bubbling, scratches, tears, or tint lifting off. Out of a dozen vehicles I’ve had tinted, this is by far the worst job. On top of that, they damaged the window seals on my hard top, scratched the exterior by cutting film against it, and even left trash inside my vehicle. Terrible workmanship all around.

Update: after going back and complaining about the job they did, I had them redo the entire car! I waited two extra days, in a total of 5 days, before rolling my windows down! They are not experienced installers and they do a rush job. You've been warned.

Please note: If you take a look at several of the poor reviews, the owner/manager keeps responding, 'this is a fake review...' to poor reviews. If you run a great business, fake reviews would be a drop in the bucket. Stop making excuses and improve your staff and business practices.
